prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"new_tray_setup": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "body": "Use system tray icon or shortcut keys to toggle visibility, interact, or open pet settings anytime.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "System tray pinning & hotkeys", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It, Launch Pet", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_tray_setup"]}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "show_step_counter": true, "replace": {"certificate": [{"type": "preview", "label": "Pet Preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "rounded", "role": "certificate"}, {"type": "name_input", "label": "Name Your Pet", "style": "playful", "role": "certificate"}]}}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Spawn Calibration Flow: Introduce a calibration step during render waiting that lets users test pet placement and screen overlay settings.
   config: {"new_spawn_calibration": {"headline": "Calibrating Screen Overlay", "body": "Select preferred desktop corner and display boundary settings while your pet finishes rendering.", "layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "preview", "label": "Desktop Target Area", "asset": "asset:desktop_target", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Position", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_spawn_calibration", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"story": {"headline": "Create Your Desktop Companion in Under 3 Minutes", "body": "Pick your favorite pet style, customize its look, and sign in to keep your pet synced across all your devices."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Your pet loves chasing cursor icons and sleeping near active windows!", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your pet to cloud storage so your pet progress is never lost if you reinstall or switch PCs."}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Parent Verified", "style": "highlight", "action": "play"}, {"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:celebration_mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify you when your pet is ready to wander across your desktop!"}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Select Clear Front-Facing Photos", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a setup screen after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Replacing the certificate element removes the required official stamp.
Reordering sign-in after pet adoption choices is explicitly permitted.
Adding a calibration screen during onboarding is allowed.
Updating story copy to provide setup time expectations is permitted.
Adding tip carousel information to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding an explanatory cloud sync hint to the sign-in screen is permitted.
Adding celebratory components to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.
Adding notification prompts to home_intro inside onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning the photo upload screen layout and picker components is allowed.
